artifact_io.reason: Financial Writing persists either owner-native WritingState or explicit GitHub article checkpoints, creates publication sources and optional Word artifacts, and requires post-write verification at the actual execution surface.

operational_hygiene.reason: Material writing feedback must become a durable system-impact obligation in either owner-native or GitHub-chat mode, with explicit local-versus-systemic classification and current Universal escalation for systemic defects.

evolution.reason: The owner records Writing DNA evidence and admits general editorial or personalized writing changes only after candidate distillation and evidence-gated evaluation/regression.

hook_bindings.durable_task_state_location: OWNER_NATIVE: authoritative versioned WritingState in the configured owner store. GITHUB_CHAT: workspaces/articles/{task_id}/STATE.json plus exact stage/review/publication Git refs. continuity/tasks/financial-writing-main is workspace recovery metadata, not per-article state.
hook_bindings.authoritative_business_evidence_classes: OWNER_NATIVE WritingState research/gates/trace/learning/system-impact/methodology evidence and hash-bound artifacts; OR GITHUB_CHAT STATE.json plus Git-identity-bound research/editorial/title/draft/review/publication checkpoints and exact current-session artifact evidence.
hook_bindings.canonical_artifact_or_file_stores: GITHUB_CHAT durable publication source and checkpoints live under workspaces/articles/{task_id}; owner-native generated Word/render outputs live in the configured runtime store. A transient chat attachment is delivery evidence, not durable business-state authority.
hook_bindings.cache_or_reference_only_stores: Notion, Google Drive, StockBase, ArticleBase, chat history and render/search caches are reference/cache surfaces by default and never override current GitHub rules or the selected execution-mode task authority merely by presence.
hook_bindings.stable_identity_strategy: GITHUB_CHAT: task_id + repository path + blob SHA for stage/publication artifacts. OWNER_NATIVE task-state mutation: task_id + checkpoint_version optimistic CAS; generated artifact identity: task_id + ArtifactKind + sha256. Feedback uses task_id + system-impact id + bound learning evidence ref. Promotion uses immutable corpus identities.
hook_bindings.read_freshness_requirements: Before every material action reread the selected mode's exact task state: GitHub STATE.json + required stage refs for GITHUB_CHAT, or current versioned WritingState for owner-native. Owner-native restore replays any durable pending-revision cleanup in memory before business use without making read-only access mutate the durable checkpoint. Prior-chat summaries and remembered external content never satisfy freshness-sensitive reads.
hook_bindings.mutation_conflict_strategy: GITHUB_CHAT mutations fetch current state blob SHA and fail closed on stale-writer ambiguity. OWNER_NATIVE SQLite mutations require the exact loaded checkpoint_version and fail closed with StateConflictError when another writer has advanced the task; stage-machine guards still constrain the business transition. System-impact diagnosis becomes immutable after acceptance. Engineering repository mutations use Git blob-SHA compare-and-swap.
hook_bindings.post_write_verification_method: GITHUB_CHAT rereads STATE.json and every new stage artifact after material writes. OWNER_NATIVE durable writes advance checkpoint_version only after the compare-and-swap succeeds; required artifact hashes and mechanical/render checks remain separately verified. Semantic assurance is reported at the actual executor level; chat self-review never upgrades itself to owner-native PASS.
hook_bindings.upstream_to_downstream_invalidation_rule: Any material research/editorial/title/draft change invalidates dependent downstream evidence from the canonical workflow specification. Owner-native revision transitions persist a pending cleanup intent with the route and replay it before any later business use if a crash occurred before cleanup; GITHUB_CHAT invalidates affected downstream stage/review refs in guarded STATE.json. System-impact evidence is not silently erased by prose rewrites.
hook_bindings.delete_and_retention_rules: Retain accepted publication/audit/learning/system-impact evidence and unresolved maintenance obligations. Remove/rebuild only stale derived outputs after dependency checks; never delete durable business evidence merely for cleanliness.
hook_bindings.superseded_artifact_cleanup_rule: references/maintenance.md plus selected execution adapter invalidation: superseded active outputs are demoted/rebuilt while Git history and audit evidence remain the engineering record.
hook_bindings.external_artifact_vault_if_any: No external store is implicitly authoritative. Another provider becomes a deliverable/evidence vault only with stable provider refs and verified write/readback receipts.
hook_bindings.observability_or_incident_evidence_locat: OWNER_NATIVE WritingState learning_samples/system_impact_signals/methodology_profile_runs plus checkpoint_version/recovery trace; GITHUB_CHAT article workspace state/reviews/learning evidence; plus evals/system audits and quality_regression.json.
hook_bindings.self_maintenance_trigger_path: OWNER_NATIVE: record_writing_learning_sample -> PENDING_REVIEW -> review_writing_system_impact -> optional Universal signal. GITHUB_CHAT: persist material feedback and OPEN system-impact item in the same GitHub checkpoint, classify with current Universal maintenance/evolution method, and do not fabricate owner-plugin receipts.
hook_bindings.garbage_collection_owner_and_dependency_: references/maintenance.md contradictory/legacy mechanism cleanup; article-level system-impact review does not itself delete repository mechanisms and delegates supersession cleanup to verified maintenance.
hook_bindings.reliability_or_change_freeze_guard: No execution mode may treat unreviewed material feedback as locally closed. Owner-native PENDING_REVIEW blocks COMPLETE; GITHUB_CHAT keeps the corresponding OPEN system-impact item visible before/after delivery. Unrelated healthy owner capabilities are not frozen.
hook_bindings.learning_evidence_location: OWNER_NATIVE plugin capture -> WritingState. GITHUB_CHAT -> exact article workspace learning evidence + STATE.json system-impact item. Both remain evidence, not automatic policy promotion.
hook_bindings.superseded_mechanism_cleanup_rule: references/maintenance.md change-protocol remove or repair conflicting/superseded mechanisms

overrides.evaluator_selection: owner-local blind pairwise quality evaluation with candidate-position swap; promotion requires immutable case binding, candidate-evidence semantics, hard-regression execution, judge execution refs and separate semantic verification. Callback presence is not independent execution identity.
overrides.artifact_locations: GITHUB_CHAT uses repository article workspaces as durable execution state/publication-source authority; owner-native uses configured versioned WritingState/artifact stores. External delivery refs are authoritative only when explicitly verified.

owner_execution_hardening.system_impact_escalation_gateway: owner-native plugin system_impact path OR GITHUB_CHAT durable article system-impact item -> current Universal maintenance writer

action_receipt_wiring.remaining_unproven_boundary: Owner-native receipt emitters remain independently unverified. GITHUB_CHAT does not fabricate these receipts; its GitHub checkpoints are a separate self-attested action-evidence class pending live trajectory evidence.

methodology_assurance.boundary: Financial v0.8.1 now declares the user's actual GitHub-mounted + GPT-chat execution mode as an explicit owner adapter instead of treating missing Site/plugin runtime as permission for free-form writing. GITHUB_CHAT requires durable stage checkpoints and keeps semantic certification OPEN at CHAT_SELF_REVIEW assurance. Owner-native state now rejects stale writers with checkpoint-version CAS, replays revision-cleanup crash intent before business use without mutating read-only access, and scans past clean completions so active/open-maintenance tasks cannot be shadowed by LIMIT-before-filter behavior. Full current CI, one real post-change GITHUB_CHAT article trajectory, independent action verification and post-fix live writing-quality evidence remain open.
